title: About Me
html:
Menelik Admasu

Computer Administrator
Hardware & Networking · Technical Trainer
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

If you're looking for a multitasking, detail-oriented computer administrator who can keep things running smoothly, I'm the right person for the job. My experience as computer staff, strong administrative skills, and extensive professional experience mean you can rely on me to handle responsibilities effectively and efficiently.

I bring hands-on experience in computer hardware, networking, technical training, web site design, and video editing — and I enjoy learning new tools and solving practical problems.

Interests

  • Attraction to new things
  • Computer coding
  • Reading books
  • Doing new things
  • Web site design & video editing

Languages

  • Amharic — Professional working proficiency
  • English — Professional working proficiency

Volunteer

Technology training for the community and organizations — teaching people how to use technology effectively.
